annotations.title: Look up domain WHOIS and RDAP records

description: Look up who registered a domain, when, and when it expires. Give domains, website URLs, or email addresses (up to 5,000). For each registrable domain the actor asks the registry's own RDAP server (from the IANA list), or its port 43 WHOIS server where there is no RDAP, and returns one row: registered true or false, registrar, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, domain_age_days, days_until_expiry, status codes, nameservers, dnssec, and the registrant organization and country where the registry publishes them. Rows with no dates published, error rows, and input that is not a domain come back free with a row_status saying so. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per domain lookup.

domain.description: One domain, URL, or email address, for example stripe.com.

domains.description: Domains, website URLs, or email addresses, up to 5,000. Subdomains are looked up as their registrable domain.

follow_registrar_rdap.description: true (default) also reads the registrar's RDAP record for the abuse email and any registrant details it publishes.

include_raw.description: true puts the registry's raw RDAP JSON or WHOIS text in raw_response. Default false.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge would pass this amount.

name: lookup_domain_whois
title: Look up domain WHOIS and RDAP records
